title: Esmolol Alleviates Sepsis-Associated Myocardial Injury by Acting on the APAF1 and JAK2/STAT3 Inflammatory Pathways.
authors: Zhao, Lei; Dong, Hua; Dong, Shimin
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨艾司洛尔通过APAF1和JAK2/STAT3通路缓解脓毒症心肌损伤，核心为药物靶点与炎症凋亡机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study is to explore the protective effect of esmolol against sepsis-associated myocardial injury (SAMI) and its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: SAMI-related differentially expressed genes were identified from the Gene Expression Omnibus database (GSE267388). Potential targets of esmolol were predicted using PharmMapper. Overlapping genes were used for enrichment and molecular docking analyses. H9C2 cells were treated with LPS to establish an injury model, followed by esmolol treatment. Cell viability, apoptosis, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial function were also assessed. The expressions of apoptotic protease activating factor 1 (APAF1) and JAK2/STAT3 pathway molecules were detected using reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and Western blotting. A rat model of sepsis was used to verify cardiac function, inflammation, oxidative stress, and related protein expression. RESULTS: Six core targets were screened, and esmolol showed the strongest binding to APAF1. Esmolol increased cell viability; reduced apoptosis, ROS, and MDA; restored mitochondrial membrane potential; downregulated APAF1, Bax, cleaved-caspase-9/3; and suppressed JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation. Esmolol reversed APAF1 overexpression-induced injury. In vivo, esmolol alleviated myocardial pathological injury, decreased the concentrations of myocardial markers and inflammatory factors, and inhibited the APAF1 and JAK2/STAT3 pathways. CONCLUSION: Esmolol protects against SAMI by dual inhibition of the APAF1 mitochondrial apoptotic and JAK2/STAT3 inflammatory pathways, with APAF1 likely serving as a key downstream target of esmolol.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨艾司洛尔对脓毒症相关心肌损伤（SAMI）的保护作用及其潜在分子机制。方法：从基因表达综合数据库（GSE267388）中鉴定SAMI相关的差异表达基因。使用PharmMapper预测艾司洛尔的潜在靶点。重叠基因用于富集分析和分子对接分析。用LPS处理H9C2细胞建立损伤模型，随后进行艾司洛尔处理。评估细胞活力、凋亡、氧化应激和线粒体功能。使用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和蛋白质印迹法检测凋亡蛋白酶激活因子1（APAF1）及JAK2/STAT3通路分子的表达。使用大鼠脓毒症模型验证心脏功能、炎症、氧化应激及相关蛋白表达。结果：筛选出六个核心靶点，艾司洛尔与APAF1结合最强。艾司洛尔增加细胞活力；减少凋亡、ROS和MDA；恢复线粒体膜电位；下调APAF1、Bax、cleaved-caspase-9/3；并抑制JAK2/STAT3磷酸化。艾司洛尔逆转了APAF1过表达诱导的损伤。在体内，艾司洛尔减轻心肌病理损伤，降低心肌标志物和炎症因子浓度，并抑制APAF1和JAK2/STAT3通路。结论：艾司洛尔通过双重抑制APAF1线粒体凋亡通路和JAK2/STAT3炎症通路保护SAMI，其中APAF1可能作为艾司洛尔的关键下游靶点。
